nodes.name: Escalation event received
nodes.notes: Signed with X-NexusFlow-Timestamp / X-NexusFlow-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of '<ts>.<raw body>').

nodes.name: Ask RAG copilot
nodes.notes: Gemini-backed; can take 10-30 s. A non-200 still produces an alert with a manual-SOP fallback.

nodes.name: Post alert to channel
nodes.notes: Slack incoming webhook (default) or Discord webhook (NEXUSFLOW_ALERT_FORMAT=discord).

nodes.name: Report to NexusFlow
nodes.notes: Full response + never error: downstream nodes branch on statusCode.

meta.description: FastAPI dispatches P1/P2 (or copilot-flagged) tickets here. Acks 202, asks the RAG copilot for the governing SOP steps, formats Slack/Discord/generic alert payloads, optionally posts to NEXUSFLOW_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL, and reports back to /api/v1/webhooks/n8n/callback.
